detail.longDescription: Something I’m not sure about from MDN or tutorial sites is whether a module is necessarily a module. If that sounds confusing, here is how it appears. I can use a module like this: // library.mjs function something() { } export {something}; // main.js import {something} from './library.mjs'; doit(); The question is how to reference it in HTML. I gather that I should import the main script as a module: <script type="module" src="main.js"></script> I understand that only modules can load other modules. It seems counter-intuitive that main.js should be regarded as a module; I always thought of a module as something you load in another script. Is this the correct understanding of this? In order to use modules treat everything as a module and forego the type="text/javascript" part?
